entities.name: Francisco
entities.description: Khalid's father, operating under the cover name Nasab ibn Khalil in Ottoman territory, sent with Ramiz to locate the Architect Cube in 1417.
entities.quote: Ramiz and Francisco — Khalid's father, operating under the cover name Nasab ibn Khalil in Ottoman territory — are sent to locate the Architect Cube.

entities.name: Dirham
entities.description: Half-blind leader of the Forgotten Ones community outside Ottoman Istanbul.
entities.quote: Dirham, half-blind, and Abbas, one-legged, led this community.

entities.name: Madhobi
entities.description: Introduced Issabela and Anthony to the Hidden Ones after the Rome cell collapse.
entities.quote: Madhobi (in-story name: Nytheris) introduced Issabela and Anthony to the Hidden Ones after the Rome collapse.

entities.name: Nullborn
entities.description: The oldest active organization in the SCU's modern story, assembled in 1417 to ignore institutional rules and handle problems officials refused to touch.
entities.quote: Nullborn is the oldest active organization in the SCU's modern story. It was assembled in 1417, and the reason it was founded tells you everything about how this universe works: the people and institutions that were supposed to protect the world had rules. Nullborn was built specifically to ignore those rules.

timeline_events.title: Nullborn Assembly
timeline_events.description: Nullborn is assembled in 1417 as a cross-faction rebellion to ignore rules and handle problems officials refused to touch.
timeline_events.quote: Nullborn is the oldest active organization in the SCU's modern story. It was assembled in 1417, and the reason it was founded tells you everything about how this universe works: the people and institutions that were supposed to protect the world had rules. Nullborn was built specifically to ignore those rules.
